summary: 28-year-old Colorado man fell 150 feet down a slope south and west of The Narrows on Longs Peak; ranger flown to summit hiked down to him; short-haul helicopter and Grand Teton NP fire crew evacuated him to the Boulderfield, then Flight for Life to St. Anthony's Hospital; ~30 rescuers, Rocky Mountain Rescue on standby
notes: NPS morning report (reported 2010-07-02): fall occurred Thursday afternoon; victim conscious and stable with numerous injuries
